facts.value: The university offers a variety of activities including numerous sports courses, cultural offerings such as the Movie Club (filming and presenting films), the English Speaking Society, and musical, theatrical, and hobby clubs where students can engage creatively and communally.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Approximately 9% of the students, which corresponds to about 1,209 international students, come from abroad, creating a multicultural environment.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Over 70% of the courses are taught in small groups of a maximum of 40 students, allowing for individual support, active participation, and close contact between teachers and students.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: Students regularly organize a varied program with performances, food stands, live music, and cultural contributions open to everyone on campus, especially during events like the Kodaira Festival or the Ikkyosai.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt

facts.value: The university offers over 150 clubs and Circles, including sports clubs, music and theater groups, as well as academic and research-related initiatives, particularly notable for their openness to international students.
facts.programme_association: German Courses - Department 02 | Goethe University Frankfurt
